product_wide_rationale: Governs which agent capabilities the main checkout refuses. It is authority law spanning every Domain, so no runtime Domain owns it.
summary: Scopes the main-checkout refusal by capability class: work_define resolves from the default checkout because it writes only Product state, while implementation-bearing capabilities stay refused. Amends CD-0072 D2 and CD-0008 D1 at that boundary.
title: Main-checkout capability scope
